dispute_ticket.description: I came straight from a work site and my shoes were muddy, but I was in a rush and the driver was rude about it. I was charged S$90 which is far too much for some dirt. Please remove the whole S$90.

chat_logs.content: Boss, your shoes got mud all over the seat and mat. I will report it, you pay.

app_events.details: Driver pre-trip photo, 18:09, plate SMB 1177 T visible: rear seats and floor mats clean.
Driver submitted claim within 6 minutes of drop-off: 4 photos timestamped 18:52-18:55, plate visible in photo 1, showing mud stains on rear seat and floor mats.

Receipt from 'ShineWorks Auto Detailing' dated 2026-10-07 08:30 for S$90.00: shampoo and steam clean of rear seat and floor mats; includes company name, contact number, address, plate SMB 1177 T, signature and stamp.
Cleaning fee S$90.00 charged to rider R-7115.

cleaning_fee_max_stains.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip when the mess is a stain such as mud, dirt, paint, cement, tar or oil.

value: cleaning company receipt with name, contact, address and date
cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver must provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only.

cleaning_claim_submission_window_hours.text: Hours after the trip ends within which a driver must submit a cleaning claim. It governs driver claims only.

rider_may_dispute_if.text: Lists the grounds on which a rider may dispute a cleaning fee charged to them.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: The pre-trip photo at 18:09 shows the seats clean, so the stain was not pre-existing. The claim was filed 6 minutes after drop-off with four timestamped photos showing the plate, and a cleaning receipt dated the next morning with company name, contact, address, plate, signature and stamp, so this trip's evidence list and 48-hour window are met. The S$90.00 fee is below this trip's S$120.00 cap for stains and matches the receipt, so none of the dispute grounds apply. The rider's hurry and the driver's curt message do not change that.
